sourcedDescription: The Titan Exchange airdrop is speculative. The team has not announced a token, a points system, or any reward for testnet users. What exists today is a waitlist with tiered status cards and a public testnet, and Titan says testnet users get early priority at mainnet.
tagline_en: The Titan Exchange airdrop is speculative. The team has not announced a token, a points system, or any reward for testnet users. What exists today is a waitlist with tiered status cards and a public testnet, and Titan says testnet users get early priority at mainnet.

sourcedSteps.title: Join the Titan Exchange Waitlist
sourcedSteps.body: Visit the Titan Exchange waitlist , connect your wallet, and sign the message.

sourcedSteps.title: Share Your Referral Link
sourcedSteps.body: Copy the referral link from your status card and share it. Each person who joins through it counts toward your next tier, from Bronze up to Diamond.

sourcedSteps.title: Open the Titan Testnet
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Titan testnet and connect the wallet you used for the waitlist.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Testnet USDC
sourcedSteps.body: Claim test USDC inside the app. These funds have no real value and exist only for trading on the testnet.

sourcedSteps.title: Enable Trading
sourcedSteps.body: Click “Enable Trading” and approve the request in your wallet. You only need to do this once per account.

sourcedSteps.title: Place a Perp Order
sourcedSteps.body: Open your first position on a market such as BTC-USDCx: Choose a market from the list Enter the order amount Set your price Confirm the order
